title: Closing: the three surviving old members and thanks
summary: He notes only three old members remain, and the interviewer thanks him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well, I think that covers most of your life pretty well, unless you have something else that you wanted to add.

No, no more than, let's see, nothing. We don't want to keep you on there. You might put, take this on record, that at this present time, there's only three of those old, except the band, living. That's Johnny Polk, Willie Valera, and Dennis Tranger. In California. I think Mr. Polk told us of that too.
All the rest of them is dead now.
Certainly feel honored to be able to talk to you and hear about this story. I've been, I've lived long enough to give you that information.
Well, thank you very much. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. Yes, sir.
